_doc: Manual cut labels made by visually inspecting contact sheets (3B3B at 1 fps; others at 2 fps, i.e. 0.5 s resolution). Fade-ins from black are excluded. Fast passages (<0.5 s shots) cannot be resolved by eye at this sampling, so labels under-count there. Detector output is compared with 1.0 s tolerance, 1-to-1 greedy matching.
